revisions.request: Keep exactly two realistic gloved hands, the holding grip and the cleaning cloth. Lengthen the pistol slide/barrel to adult-handgun proportions, about 25% longer than the short draft. Draw one unmistakable curved trigger INSIDE its complete trigger guard, with a broad black gap around it. No third hand, floating trigger or extra guard.

Completely redraw according to the GM's new direction: one realistic adult hand grips a KATANA with a gently curved single-edged blade and plain circular guard, blade diagonal up-right. The OFF HAND is empty and held beside it in a compact martial guard position, fingers naturally extended together and palm angled toward the viewer. Exactly two anatomically correct hands, one katana. NO scabbard, draw gesture, sleeves shaped like hands, extra weapon or armoured figure.

Keep the crossed butcher knife and pliers in front of the rib outline. Repair the pliers: two straight continuous handles below the pivot, no V-shaped kink, hooked grip or bent handle. Two recognisable open jaws above the pivot. Only these TWO tools form the X; no extra tool or gore.

Preserve the crowbar levering at the front lip of the crate, but make its flattened hooked working tip distinct from the crate wall, with a broad black separation contour around the tip apart from its small real contact/fulcrum. The crowbar must not fuse with the crate. Enlarge the raised rectangular lid to clearly cover the whole crate when closed, with visible hinges and a large coherent slab.

Keep the underwater swimmer, head, front arms, waterline and air bubble. Rebuild the rear half as a natural human pelvis and exactly TWO proportional human legs: one leg trails straight behind, the other bends gently at a single knee, both ending in recognisable feet. No fused hips, extra legs, backwards knees, fins or animal parts.

Keep the barter trader, offered canteen, second hand and goods crate. Zoom out enough that the full cap and head are complete, with generous empty space above them. No flat cropped crown, clipped cap or missing shoulders. Preserve the useful barter gesture.

Reframe to show the COMPLETE head and menacing face of the rugged butcher, upper torso and apron. Raise the hand holding a heavy short-handled butcher's axe/hatchet to beside the shoulder, with the entire blade visible. Focus on the stern face, broad shoulders and raised tool; no clipped skull, cropped blade, dog or gore.

Preserve the electronic console with broad control, traces and two buttons. Replace the cartoon oversized glove/finger with an anatomically plausible adult hand in a close-fitting plain work glove: normal-sized palm, four proportional fingers, a distinct thumb, one straight index finger presses the large control. No inflated cartoon glove, mitten, giant cuff or extra finger.

fresh.name: Barbarka

fresh.name: Ciszej niż cień

fresh.name: Człowiek-pająk

fresh.name: Fabrykator

fresh.name: Fachowiec

fresh.name: Immunitet
